cohort: Eight patients from three unrelated consanguineous families with novel deleterious variants in UBE3B, presenting with Kaufman oculocerebrofacial syndrome (KOS).
finding: This study identified three novel deleterious variants in UBE3B in eight patients from Saudi Arabia, expanding the known phenotypic spectrum of Kaufman oculocerebrofacial syndrome (KOS) to include a marfanoid body habitus in one family.
